description.en: HyperImageNet is a dataset of 26,084 airborne hyperspectral image patches with 224 spectral bands and 138 fine-grained land-cover categories, providing raw imagery, pixel-level semantic labels, and object-level instance masks for semantic and instance segmentation, along with an open-environment evaluation protocol.
